name: bug_unresolved_family_drops_text
description: Text asking for a font-family that resolves to NOTHING must still reach the framebuffer, in a fallback face. An unresolved family is the normal case, not an error: the shipped 0.2.0 widgets demo asks for Cantarell (GNOME's UI font, absent on KDE and most non-GNOME Linux), Sans and system:ui and gets '[azul][font] UNRESOLVED font-family' for all three on a stock KDE box. That warning is correct. What must never follow is the next line the shipped demo printed — '[cpurender] Font hash ... not found in FontManager' — i.e. layout shaping a run with a face the renderer then cannot resolve, so the text is silently dropped with only an eprintln. Layout and render now share ONE font lookup (FontManager::resolve_font_by_hash, covering both the loaded faces and the embedded StyleFontFamily::Ref faces), so a hash layout emitted always resolves at raster time. This scenario pins the contract end to end: mounting text in a family nothing can match must grow the font tables (a fallback WAS resolved and loaded) and must actually paint (damage is produced and the frame changes).

css: #txt  { font-family: "Definitely Not Installed Sans", Cantarell; font-size: 32px; color: black; }
